target_customer: Data, product and engineering teams that present metrics to colleagues
problem: Presentations rely on screenshots and pasted tables, which go stale and can misreport data.
business_model: SaaS subscription for AI assisted presentation software with live data connections

founders.name: Dori Wilson
founders.background_notes: Data scientist turned CEO per YC launch post.

founders.name: John Stimac
founders.role: Founder, frontend, backend and data engineering

technical_complexity.rationale: A slide editor with a design system, live data connectors and an LLM assistant is standard engineering with some hard layout problems for a team of two to three.

defensibility.rationale: Presentation editors with AI were copyable quickly by Google, Microsoft, Canva and several startups; no data or network lock in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large suites added AI features. A search result also noted AI deck startup Tome shut down in April 2025, showing weak demand in the category.

market_need_then: The launch post argues that screenshots and pasted tables cause miscommunicated data, but no usage or spend evidence was found.

brand_strength.rationale: Only a word mark registration (filed February 2024, registered December 2025) and directory pages were found; no brand press.

pivots.why: Not stated; reported by one directory profile

outcome_analysis: Thorntale built an AI presentation editor in a category where large suites and well funded startups moved faster, raised about 500 thousand dollars, shipped a review tool in late 2025 and announced a shutdown in December 2025 according to one directory. The company stated cause is not public, so these factors are inference from the market and the small raise.
notes: Funding rests on a single database (CB Insights) and conflicts on type (convertible note January 2024 versus pre-seed February 2024); CB says 500K over 2 rounds so one round is missing. Shutdown date rests on one aggregator, no official announcement found. Website fetch returned 503. YC launch post names no competitors and no dated competitor source found, so the list is empty.
